name: Exp_CronexMFI
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the CronexMFI custom indicator, which applies double smoothing to the Market Facilitation Index (MFI). It opens buy positions when the main MFI line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CronexMFI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对市场促进指数(MFI)进行了双重平滑处理。当主线向上穿越信号线时开多仓，反之开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于CronexMFI指标的双重平滑MFI交叉信号，属于动量类策略。入场条件为：当指标主线(Ind)位于信号线(Sign)之上时，若前一根K线的主线低于或等于信号线（即刚发生向上交叉），则开多仓；反之，当主线在信号线之下且前一根K线发生向下交叉时，开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈（分别默认1000和2000点），以及信号反转时平仓（可独立开关控制）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，支持多种保证金模式包括固定手数(LOT)模式。资金管理支持四种模式：可用保证金比例、余额比例、考虑浮亏的可用保证金比例、考虑浮亏的余额比例以及固定手数。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on crossover signals from the CronexMFI indicator, which applies double smoothing (configurable smoothing method for fast and slow periods) to the Market Facilitation Index, classifying it as a momentum strategy. Entry conditions: when the main indicator line (Ind) is above the signal line (Sign) and the previous bar showed the main line at or below the signal line (upward crossover), a buy position is opened; conversely, when the main line is below the signal line and a downward crossover occurred, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include configurable Stop Loss (default 1000 points) and Take Profit (default 2000 points), plus signal-reversal-based closing with independent enable/disable switches for buy and sell position closures. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1), supporting multiple margin modes including fixed lot size (LOT) mode. Money management supports four modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin accounting for floating loss, and percentage of balance accounting for floating loss, plus a fixed lot mode. The strategy also employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation happens only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：可用保证金/余额/含浮亏保证金/含浮亏余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lots)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许信号反转时平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow buy to close position (reverse signal closes short)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许信号反转时平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow sell to close position (reverse signal closes long)

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：tick成交量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于判断交叉信号的K线索引（1=前一根已完成的K线）

pros: 使用双重平滑MFI指标，相比原始MFI减少了虚假信号，提高了信号质量
支持多种平滑算法（10种），可根据不同市场特性灵活调整
买入和卖出的开仓与平仓可独立控制，提供了灵活的策略配置
采用IsNewBar机制限制每根K线只计算一次信号，避免了重复入场
止损止盈配置完整，默认止盈为止损的2倍，具有正期望收益比
pros_en: Uses double-smoothed MFI indicator which reduces false signals compared to raw MFI, improving signal quality
Supports 10 different smoothing algorithms, allowing flexible adaptation to different market characteristics
Buy and sell opening and closing can be independently controlled, providing flexible strategy configuration
Employs IsNewBar mechanism to limit signal calculation to once per bar, preventing duplicate entries
Complete stop loss and take profit configuration with default TP at 2x SL, implying a positive reward-to-risk ratio
cons: 缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能导致不必要的亏损入场
没有多时间周期确认机制，单一指标交叉信号可能产生较多虚假信号
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值较大，可能不适用于所有品种和波动率环境
没有对已有同方向持仓的检查，可能导致重复加仓
依赖外部自定义指标CronexMFI和两个包含文件，部署和移植较复杂
cons_en: Lacks spread filter mechanism, which may lead to unnecessary losing entries during high spread conditions
No multi-timeframe confirmation, single indicator crossover signals may generate numerous false signals
Default SL of 1000 and TP of 2000 points are large values, may not suit all instruments and volatility environments
No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to repeated position stacking
Depends on external custom indicator CronexMFI and two include files, making deployment and portability complex
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免高滑点成本
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致过度杠杆
增加多时间周期趋势确认，例如更高周期趋势方向一致时才允许入场
improvements_en: Add spread filter to pause opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding high slippage costs
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries that lead to excessive leverage
Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation, e.g., only allow entries when the higher timeframe trend direction aligns

risk_points: 没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能在信号持续期间反复加仓
默认止损1000点较大，在高波动市场中单笔亏损可能较大
依赖外部指标文件，若缺失则初始化失败但不会影响已有持仓
risk_points_en: No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially stacking positions during persistent signals
Default 1000-point SL is large, single trade loss could be significant in high volatility markets
Depends on external indicator file; if missing, initialization fails but existing positions are unaffected
